t.Como o ChatGPT e outras IAs escolhem qua: How ChatGPT and other AIs choose which businesses to recommend, how to test in 2 minutes whether your business shows up, and what to adjust if you're left out.
t.Seu negócio aparece no ChatGPT? Por que: Does your business show up on ChatGPT? Why AI became the new local Google
t.Uma parte dos seus clientes já não digit: Some of your customers no longer type "auto repair near me" into Google. They open ChatGPT and ask: "what's the best auto repair shop in Ipiranga?". The AI answers with three or four names, reasons included. If your business isn't on that list, you didn't lose a position — you simply weren't considered. This guide explains how AIs choose whom to recommend, how to test in two minutes whether you show up, and what you can adjust when the answer is no.
t.Faça um teste rápido antes de continuar: Do a quick test before reading on. Open ChatGPT and ask which is the best business in your category in your city or neighborhood. If you run a salon in Campinas, ask "what are the best beauty salons in Campinas?". Read the answer carefully.
t.Duas coisas costumam chamar atenção. A p: Two things usually stand out. First: the AI answers with conviction, naming specific businesses, a rough address and a summary of what people say about each one. Second: the list is short. Three, four, five businesses. There's no page 2. There's no "see more results". It's a shop window with four spots for an entire city.
t.O que mudou de verdade: a busca ganhou u: What really changed: search gained a middleman
t.No Google, o cliente vê uma lista e esco: On Google, the customer sees a list and chooses. They scan ten results, compare stars, look at photos, decide. You could be in fifth place and still get the click because fifth place was on the screen.
t.Na busca via IA, alguém escolhe antes de: In AI search, someone chooses before you appear. The model does the research, reads the sources, filters and delivers what it judged relevant as a ready-made answer. The customer gets a recommendation, not a list. And they tend to trust it, because the answer looks like advice, not an ad.
t.Isso não significa que o Google morreu —: That doesn't mean Google is dead — far from it. For local businesses, Maps is still by far the main discovery channel, and that's where most of your effort should stay. What changed is that a second counter has opened, still small but growing, with its own rules and almost no competitor paying attention to it.
t.Como as IAs escolhem quais negócios reco: How AIs choose which businesses to recommend
t.Na prática, essa matéria-prima vem de al: In practice, that raw material comes from a few predictable places:
t.1. Seu perfil do Google e o Maps: 1. Your Google Business Profile and Maps
t.2. Avaliações — volume, recência e o que: 2. Reviews — volume, recency and what they say
t.Duas implicações concretas. Primeira: ne: Two concrete implications. First: a business with 8 reviews rarely has enough material to be cited, even with a 5.0 rating. Second: the words your customers use become the attributes you're recommended for. A bakery with twenty reviews mentioning "bread fresh out of the oven at 5 pm" has a shot at showing up in the answer to "where to buy warm bread in the late afternoon" — something no profile setting could ever produce.
t.3. Consistência dos seus dados pela inte: 3. Consistency of your data across the internet
t.Nome, endereço e telefone iguais no Goog: The same name, address and phone number on Google, your website, Instagram, iFood, Doctoralia and local directories. When this data doesn't match, the model has two versions of the same business and no clear reference — and the most common outcome is that it simply doesn't mention you rather than risk getting it wrong.
t.4. Um site que possa ser lido: 4. A website that can be read
t.Não precisa de site bonito, precisa de s: You don't need a pretty website, you need a readable one: real text saying what you do, for whom, in which city and neighborhood, with your address, hours and services written out in words. A site that's just one big image, or that only loads content after scrolling and clicking, gives the robot little to read. If you only have Instagram, you depend even more on your Google Business Profile.
t.5. Menções em fontes que a IA considera: 5. Mentions in sources the AI considers trustworthy
t.Lista de \"melhores hamburguerias da cid: A "best burger joints in town" list on a local portal, a story in a neighborhood paper, a regional blog, a business association, a forum, Reddit. These texts are exactly the format the model looks for when the question is "which is the best". A mention in a local guide can weigh more than ten of your own Instagram posts, because it's a third party's voice.
t.O teste de 2 minutos: descubra se você a: The 2-minute test: find out whether you show up
t.Não dá pra melhorar o que você não mediu: You can't improve what you haven't measured. Run this test before changing anything — and write the answers down, because they change over time and the comparison is what matters.
t.Perguntas pro teste · troque categoria e: Test questions · swap in your own category and city
t.\"Quais as melhores clínicas odontológic: "What are the best dental clinics in Santo André?"
t.\"Preciso de uma oficina mecânica de con: "I need a trustworthy auto repair shop in São Paulo's North Zone, which one do you recommend?"
t.\"Onde almoçar bem e barato perto do cen: "Where can I get a good, cheap lunch near downtown Curitiba?"
t.\"Qual salão de beleza em Belo Horizonte: "Which beauty salon in Belo Horizonte has the best reviews?"

t.O que fazer se você não aparece: What to do if you don't show up
t.A má notícia: não existe botão de cadast: The bad news: there's no sign-up button. The good news: since the sources are the same as always, almost everything that improves your presence in AI is work that was already worth doing for Google.
t.E tem uma coisa que não custa nada: se a: And there's one thing that costs nothing: if the AI says something wrong about you — old hours, an address you've moved from, a service you don't offer —, the fix is at the source. Correct it on your Google Business Profile, your website and directories. Answers update as the sources change, although that can take weeks.
t.O que não funciona (e pode custar caro): What doesn't work (and can cost you dearly)
t.Sempre que aparece um canal novo, aparec: Whenever a new channel appears, an industry of shortcuts appears with it. Here the shortcuts are especially bad, because the AI's main input is your Google Business Profile — so whoever games Google sabotages themselves in both places at once.
t.Comece medindo onde você está hoje: Start by measuring where you stand today
t.Antes de ajustar qualquer coisa, vale ve: Before adjusting anything, it's worth checking your presence on Google — rating, volume and recency of reviews — compared with competitors in your category and area. It's this same material that AIs read when deciding whom to cite. The diagnosis is free and takes less than a minute.
t.Ao mesmo tempo, dois fatos empurram na d: At the same time, two facts push the other way. First: the foundation that makes you show up in AI is the same one that makes you show up on Maps, so it isn't double work — it's the same work measured in two places. Second: almost none of your competitors has tested this yet. Running the two-minute test today and fixing whatever comes up wrong is cheap now and will get expensive later, when everyone is paying attention.
t.As IAs recomendam negócios locais com ba: AIs recommend local businesses based on what's publicly available about them — mainly the Google Business Profile, the content of reviews, data consistency, website text and mentions in local sources. Nobody publishes the exact criteria and nobody can guarantee a mention, so treat it as probability, not registration. Run the two-minute test on more than one AI, note who shows up in your place, fix whatever is wrong at the sources and keep a steady flow of real, recent reviews. And avoid shortcuts: bought reviews and filtering who reviews you put at risk the very profile that feeds both channels at once.

h.Vale dizer o que ninguém sabe: nenhuma e: It's worth saying what nobody knows: no AI company publishes its criteria for choosing local businesses, and answers vary from one day to the next, from one user to another and even between two identical questions. Anyone who promises to "put your business on ChatGPT" is selling a certainty that doesn't exist. What does exist are signals that increase your chances — and those are what you can work on.
h.Quando você pergunta sobre negócios de u: When you ask about businesses in a city, the model rarely answers "from memory". It searches the web on the spot, reads what it found and summarizes it. That has a huge practical consequence: what the AI says about you reflects what exists publicly about you. You can't edit the answer; you can improve the raw material.
h.É a fonte mais rica que existe sobre neg: It's the richest source there is about a local business: name, category, address, hours, phone, photos, rating and review text, all structured and up to date. An incomplete profile or one with the wrong category is the number one cause of invisibility — both on Maps and in AI. If you haven't combed through yours yet, start by optimizing your Google Business Profile section by section.
h.Aqui está a parte que costuma surpreende: Here's the part that usually surprises people. AIs don't just weigh the rating; they read the text of reviews and extract themes. That's why the answer comes out as "highly praised for fast service and fair prices" — that wasn't in a profile field, it was written by customers.
h.Pergunte como um cliente perguntaria. Ca: Ask the way a customer would. Category + city or neighborhood. Never start by asking for your own name.
h.Repita em mais de uma IA. ChatGPT, Gemin: Repeat it on more than one AI. ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity read different sources and give different answers. Showing up on one and not the others is the most common result.
Ask the same question about 5 different ways. A single mention in one question doesn't mean much; showing up in 4 out of 5 is consistent presence.
h.Anote quem aparece no seu lugar. Os nome: Note who shows up in your place. The names the AI cites are your real competitors on this channel — and looking at their Google profiles quickly shows what they have that you don't.
h.Só no fim, pergunte pelo seu nome. \"O q: Only at the end, ask for your name. "What do you know about [business name] in [city]?" This doesn't measure whether you're recommended, but it shows whether the information going around about you is correct — and it's scary how often the hours or phone number are wrong.
h.Cuidado com o teste enviesado. Se você p: Watch out for a biased test. If you ask "is my store good?" or "is [your name] trustworthy?", the AI will be kind to you — and that measures nothing. The test that matters is the one the customer would do: they don't know your name, which is exactly why they're asking.
h.Complete o perfil do Google até o último: Fill in your Google Business Profile down to the last field. Correct primary category, secondary categories, a description written with the words customers use, services listed one by one, up-to-date hours (holidays included), recent photos. This is the foundation of both channels.
h.Padronize seus dados em todo lugar. Esco: Standardize your data everywhere. Pick one official spelling of your name, one address and one phone number, and correct them wherever they differ — website, social media, marketplaces, old directories you forgot existed.
h.Construa volume constante de avaliação r: Build a steady flow of real reviews. Recency counts: ten reviews a month, every month, signal an active business better than two hundred bunched up in 2023. This is where most people get stuck, and it's the item with the most positive side effects. If you need a method, see the 7 strategies to get more reviews.
h.Responda as avaliações — todas. Resposta: Reply to reviews — all of them. A reply is extra public text about your business, written by you, attached to your profile. It works for the customer who reads it and for the model that reads it.
h.Escreva no site o que você faz e onde. U: Write on your website what you do and where. One page per main service, with the neighborhood and city in the text, in plain Portuguese. This fixes much of the invisibility of businesses that only have a pretty landing page.
h.Busque menção local legítima. Guia de ba: Seek legitimate local mentions. Neighborhood guides, regional portals, business associations, partnerships with neighboring businesses. Not bought links — showing up where your city is being talked about.
h.Comprar avaliações. É fraude, o Google d: Buying reviews. It's fraud, Google keeps getting better at detecting it, and removals come in batches, knocking down your rating and volume overnight. And since AI reads reviews, bought reviews produce generic, repetitive text — which creates no attribute you'd be recommended for. You pay to get worse. We detail the damage in is buying Google reviews worth it?
h.Filtrar quem avalia (review gating). Per: Filtering who reviews you (review gating). Asking first whether the customer was happy and sending only those who said yes to Google violates Google's policies and exposes your profile to mass removal or suspension. Beyond the risk, it creates a 100% five-star profile that sounds fake to whoever reads it — person or machine. The door to Google has to be the same for every customer, praise or criticism.
h.Encher texto de palavra-chave pra \"agra: Stuffing text with keywords to "please the AI". A business name packed with terms ("Padaria Melhor Pão Barato Tijuca 24h") violates Google's naming policy and disappears once reported.
h.Serviço que promete \"garantir sua empre: Services that promise to "guarantee your business on ChatGPT". Nobody controls a model's answer. You can improve your chances, but you can't guarantee a mention — be wary of anyone who claims otherwise, including us.
h.Sejamos honestos sobre o tamanho: hoje,: Let's be honest about the size: today, for most Brazilian local businesses, AI search brings a fraction of the traffic that Google Maps brings. If you have to choose where to put your energy this week, put it into showing up well on Maps. That's not conservative advice — it's where the customers are.
